name: שֵׂעִיר
gloss: Seir, the hill country of the Horites and later of Esau
summary: Seir is the hill country where the Horites lived and where Esau later settled, and Seir the Horite, ancestor of its first inhabitants. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: Seir names the hill country in which the attackers struck the Horites.
The verse names the Horites as the former inhabitants of Seir and says that Esau’s descendants displaced them.
“These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `cee3iyr`, filed under the place name’s own consonants (שׂעיר). Genesis 14:6 establishes its geographical sense but gives no etymology; a tie to שֵׂעָר “hair” or שָׂעִיר “goat” is not shown. Seir@Gen.36.20, the Horite, is added as a bearer of the same spelling.
